name: motion-workspace
description: Espace de travail du moteur : le cœur (@motion-engine/core), les packs de données, les exemples et les tests d'intégration.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run golden:verify:p1.6 && npm run test:p1.6 && npm run test:contamination && npm run test:isolation && npm run test:renderer-smoke
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @motion-engine/core && npm run typecheck -w @motion-engine/renderer-remotion && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @motion-engine/core && npm run lint -w @motion-engine/renderer-remotion && eslint .
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run golden:verify:p1.6 && npm run test:p1.6 && npm run test:contamination && npm run test:isolation && npm run test:renderer-smoke
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @motion-engine/core && npm run test -w @motion-engine/renderer-remotion
scripts.test:integration: vitest run integration/examples.test.ts integration/boundaries.test.ts integration/pipeline.test.ts integration/p1.3-pipeline.test.ts integration/p1.4-pipeline.test.ts integration/p1.5-pipeline.test.ts
